name: Chicken Tacos with Spicy Mango, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Salsa
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallot and garlic; add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl; add salt and stir to combine the mango salsa. Set aside.
Remove lettuce leaves from head, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with chicken, lettuce, and mango salsa. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
